name: dmengine-fumo-resume-restart
description: Mode C FUMO resume across a dmengine restart: phase 1 serves a 64/184 partial with Accept-Ranges/ETag, then the engine is stopped with dlresume.dat written. Phase 2 restarts the engine with dm_state=1 and a Range-capable mock; it sends Range: bytes=64-, receives the remaining 120 bytes via 206, completes the DL session and advances FUMO state (phase 2 truncates the log at 40/50). No install or update-success claim is made.
